question: Does broader independent medium-group coverage make the fixed width-64 IC8 B2 correction generalize from train fit groups to disjoint train calibration groups?
hypothesis: The v3 failure was dominated by same-panel record fitting. Holding architecture, loss, optimizer, anchor, IC count, and total gradient record exposure approximately fixed while increasing fit coverage from 75 development groups to 240 train groups will produce seed-consistent calibration gains.
mechanism: More independent velocity/source groups constrain the shared recurrent correction toward a conditional propagation rule instead of a record-specific residual. No new loss, architecture, selector, or validation feedback is introduced.
one_variable: group-disjoint train coverage and protocol; v3 width-64 FrameConditionedPropagator recipe remains fixed

design.checkpoint_selection: minimum calibration aggregate relative L2 over epochs; both seeds must pass independently

calibration_gate.primary_metric: per-record relative L2 on frames 8 through 63 averaged over 60 calibration records
calibration_gate.family_gate: candidate mean must be strictly below the same-panel warp anchor for uniform, layered, and marmousi
calibration_gate.seed_gate: aggregate, nonworse, and family gates must pass for both seeds
calibration_gate.failure_signal: if either seed fails any subgate, reject the fixed B2 architecture before opening confirmation cache or metrics

confirmation_gate_frozen_now.opening_condition: both calibration seed gates pass and output checkpoint hashes are recorded without code or hyperparameter changes
confirmation_gate_frozen_now.evaluation_count: one evaluation per seed on the complete 60-record confirmation manifest
confirmation_gate_frozen_now.family_gate: candidate mean must be strictly below the same-panel warp anchor for all three families
confirmation_gate_frozen_now.seed_gate: all subgates must pass for both seeds
confirmation_gate_frozen_now.failure_signal: reject B2-v4 and do not open validation or test_id

data_access.fit_truth: future train truth is used for optimization
data_access.calibration_truth: future train truth is used for checkpoint selection and the frozen calibration gate
data_access.confirmation_truth: manifest and onset windows are frozen, but no confirmation cache or future metric may be created until the calibration opening condition passes
data_access.model_inputs: static medium/source features, first eight true frames, and solve-free warp anchor

rollback: additive run from scratch; preserve all v2/v3 and protected A3/B2-H/Helmholtz/ASAM/CPADC checkpoints
claim_scope: A calibration pass authorizes only one frozen train-confirmation evaluation. It is not validation, test_id, target achievement, or runtime evidence.
